description: This Java source file defines the EntityClause class used within the Apache OFBiz framework to construct and manage entity query clauses involving relations between entities. It handles entities, fields, and operations used for query conditions.

classes.name: EntityClause
classes.description: Represents a query clause linking entities, fields, and operations in the OFBiz entity framework.

methods.name: EntityClause
methods.description: Default constructor for creating an empty entity clause.

methods.name: EntityClause
methods.description: Overloaded constructor to initialize an entity clause with specified entities, fields, and operations.

methods.name: getFirstEntity
methods.description: Returns the name of the first entity involved in the clause.

methods.name: getSecondEntity
methods.description: Returns the name of the second entity involved in the clause.

methods.name: getFirstField
methods.description: Returns the name of the first field involved in the clause.

methods.name: getSecondField
methods.description: Returns the name of the second field involved in the clause.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value associated with the clause, initializing it if null.

methods.name: getInterFieldOperation
methods.description: Returns the operation applied between fields of different entities.

methods.name: getIntraFieldOperation
methods.description: Returns the operation applied within the same entity's fields.

methods.name: setFirstEntity
methods.description: Sets the name of the first entity.

methods.name: setSecondEntity
methods.description: Sets the name of the second entity.

methods.name: setInterFieldOperation
methods.description: Assigns the operation for inter-entity field comparison.

methods.name: setIntraFieldOperation
methods.description: Assigns the operation for intra-entity field comparison.

methods.name: setModelEntities
methods.description: Initializes the model entity references using a ModelReader.

methods.name: getFirstModelEntity
methods.description: Returns the ModelEntity corresponding to the first entity.

methods.name: getSecondModelEntity
methods.description: Returns the ModelEntity corresponding to the second entity.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the EntityClause object.
